paras: The Michoacán slender blind snake (Rena bressoni), also known commonly as la culebrilla ciega de Michoacán in Spanish, is a species of snake in the family Leptotyphlopidae. The species is endemic to Michoacán, Mexico.
The specific name, bressoni, is in honor of Julio Raymond Bresson, who collected the type specimen.
The preferred natural habitat of R. bressoni is forest.
R. bressoni is terrestrial and fossorial.
